Requirements: R-13
Plan row: TS-9

## Given

The reviewer has access to the merge request diff for `testproject1-backend`. No stand is required; this is a static diff review.

## When

The reviewer reads the README migration or release-note section and judges whether the note for existing operators is present and adequate.

## Then

1. P-migration-note-present: the diff includes a migration note that names `CODE_EXECUTOR_SECURITY_THRESHOLD=LOW` as affected by the semantics fix; the note is NOT absent.
2. P-enforcement-change-stated: the note states that enforcement for `LOW` has changed; it is NOT generic release prose.
3. P-default-change-noted: the note identifies that the default has changed from `LOW` to `HIGH`.

If the note is absent or does not address all three points, the reviewer records which partition failed and the actual text.
